title: Provider-free model cost lookup must iterate catalog providers in sorted order
answers: model cost differs between machines for the same model name
provider-free cost lookup picks a different catalog entry on Linux vs macOS
LLM cost is inconsistent when no model_provider is set
why does calculated span cost vary across platforms
body:
Symptom: a span's calculated cost for a model name with no provider differs between machines or operating systems, even though the code and pricing are the same.
Root cause: mlflow/utils/providers.py:_list_provider_names returned the raw Path.glob("*.json") order, which depends on the filesystem, so the first catalog hit for an ambiguous model name varied.
Fix pattern: wrap the listing in sorted(...) so provider iteration order is fixed. Keep any new listing of bundled catalog files sorted too.
Constraints: this covers the provider-free path only. When a model_provider is passed, no cross-provider scan happens and the sort is irrelevant. Pinned by assert providers == sorted(providers) in tests/utils/test_providers.py:test_list_provider_names_returns_bundled_providers.
applies: Any code that enumerates bundled provider catalogs to resolve a model name without an explicit provider.
says: Calculated LLM span costs differ between Linux and Mac for identical model runs.
Model cost tracking reports inconsistent pricing for the same model across different computers.
Tracing displays different token expenditure totals depending on which operating system runs.
Model expense calculation should return identical pricing regardless of the deployment host platform.
Ensure automated cost tracking chooses the same catalog pricing on all developer machines.
search: Provider-free model cost lookup must sort bundled provider catalog listings using sorted(...) in mlflow/utils/providers.py:_list_provider_names. This ensures a consistent catalog provider iteration order across machines and operating systems when resolving model names without an explicit provider. It applies only when no model_provider is set, leaving explicit provider lookups unaffected, and is pinned by assert providers == sorted(providers) in tests/utils/test_providers.py:test_list_provider_names_returns_bundled_providers.
